segments.sn45.42-47:1.1: 42-47. “Sace vo, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ –
segments.sn45.42-47:1.2: ‘kimatthiyaṃ, āvuso, samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatī’ti, evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe, bhikkhave, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākareyyātha –
segments.sn45.42-47:1.3: ‘saṃyojanappahānatthaṃ kho, āvuso, bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī’ti … pe …‘anusayasamugghātanatthaṃ kho, āvuso, bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī’ti … pe …‘addhānapariññatthaṃ kho, āvuso, bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī’ti … pe …‘āsavānaṃ khayatthaṃ kho, āvuso, bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī’ti … pe …‘vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyatthaṃ kho, āvuso, bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī’ti … pe …‘ñāṇadassanatthaṃ kho, āvuso, bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī’ti … pe ….
